title: Task24b Provider Connection and Capability Discovery

manualReview.reviewer: Hephaestus with project Playwright Chromium runtime

environment.browserDevice: Playwright Chromium at 390px, 1100px, and 1366px workbench widths
environment.surfaces: Provider settings, AI chat, and document Copilot

manualReview.summary: The connection-first provider workflow passed final browser and code review after enforcing server-owned native/custom probes, row-locked verification and synchronization attempts, safe capability reconciliation, explicit-default preservation, metadata-only auditing, and responsive bilingual model selection. Unsupported and malformed discovery remain recoverable through retry or Advanced fallback, secrets never leave Jixia, and the rejected Task21f manual-profile-first experience was not reproduced.
evidence: apps/web/e2e/provider-connection.spec.ts: create, save, verify, synchronize, Jixia-only browser traffic, unsupported discovery, and Advanced fallback
Final isolated Chromium suite: 15/15 tests passed at JIXIA_E2E_WEB_PORT=5673 and JIXIA_E2E_API_PORT=4674
Focused shared/DB/API/web review: shared 2/2, DB 9/9, API config and adapter 52/52, web AI surfaces 22/22
Full workspace verification: 260 tests, lint, type-check, Prisma validate/generate, production build, and git diff check passed
Final five-part review: goal PASS, hands-on QA PASS, code quality PASS, security PASS, context/history PASS
passedChecks: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Anthropic, and custom OpenAI-compatible connections use server-owned, non-billable verification and discovery protocols.
Custom endpoints enforce HTTPS, public resolved IPv4/IPv6 destinations, pinned DNS, no redirects, bounded timeout, and bounded response bodies.
Encrypted credentials and provider payloads are absent from browser traffic, shared DTOs, logs, errors, fixtures, and metadata-only audit details.
Row-locked verification and discovery attempt tokens prevent stale endpoint or credential generations from overwriting current state.
Synchronization preserves manual profiles, display names, runtime overrides, enabled/default choices, and records accurate created/updated/skipped audit counts.
Empty, unsupported, rate-limited, unavailable, malformed, stale, and preflight outcomes remain distinguishable and recoverable.
AI settings, chat, and document Copilot retained compact bilingual model selection, context controls, server-owned execution, and no-writeback behavior at all required widths.
Task21f remained archived manual-review-failed and was not modified or reopened.
manualReview.notes: The production build retains the existing Vite warning for a JavaScript chunk larger than 500 kB; it is non-blocking and outside Task24b scope. The lockfile change is limited to Node 20-compatible undici 7.28.0 required by the bounded provider transport.
